hero.industry: Cloud Services & AI Enablement for Enterprise India

business_model.title: Positioning (investor deck)
business_model.body:
- One of India's fastest-growing cloud and digital transformation partners, positioned at the intersection of high-growth Cloud, Cybersecurity, and AI, with an asset-light, annuity-heavy growth model and proven scalability.
- Deep AWS expertise: Premier AWS Partner, recognized as AWS Consulting Partner of the Year 2025, with globally recognized accreditations; BSE SME listed company.
- Mid-market & Enterprise focus via a high-touch, services-led engagement model, with strong delivery/execution credibility and customer intimacy.
- Diversified revenue mix by vertical: IT/ITES 36.85%, FSI/BFSI 34.21%, Others 16.24%, Media 5.14%, Manufacturing 4.61%, E-Commerce 2.95%.

segment_detail.title: Segment / subsidiary detail
segment_detail.body: Cloud foundation & migration: core; Managed services: 82.5% of revenue; AI acceleration: INR 2cr revenue in FY26 (influenced INR 10cr+ cloud revenue); Security: growing practice; FinOps: embedded in managed services

order_book.title: Order book & pipeline
order_book.body: INR 190cr visible: INR 160cr contracted recurring revenue (INR 13.5cr MRR), INR 30cr pipeline (Agentic AI, manufacturing analytics, insurer transformation, fintech cloud migration)

guidance.title: Guidance
guidance.body: revenue growth: 45% to INR 210cr; margin: PAT margin target ~11.5-12% (INR 24-25cr PAT); order inflow: INR 20cr incremental new business needed in 10 months; capex/commissioning: minimal (cloud infrastructure via AWS); no capex beyond headcount

growth_optionality.title: Growth verticals / optionality
growth_optionality.body: Global expansion (U.S. billing entity in progress, Singapore scaling); AI productization (IntelliOps platform for marketplace); enterprise account expansion (7-8 deals in pipeline for Q2); SMB-to-enterprise shift

margins.title: Margins & cost dynamics
margins.body: EBITDA margin down due to INR 6cr headcount investment (170 FTEs) and INR 7.5cr revenue loss; normalized PAT margin 14-15%; FY27 margin recovery via: (1) higher-margin AI/security mix, (2) utilization from 84% to 88%, (3) AI-driven productivity (IntelliOps reducing L1 load); employee cost: INR 9-10L/head, expected to rise to INR 11-12L/head with AI reskilling

capital_allocation.title: Capital allocation
capital_allocation.body: Reinvest in AI/security practice; hire enterprise sales leaders; build U.S. billing entity (light model: fractional consultants); no dividends or buybacks mentioned

management_tone.title: Management quality / tone
management_tone.body: Confident, strategic, and disciplined; emphasized AI as next engine, recurring revenue depth, and prudent capital allocation; rejected high-revenue Dubai deal due to credit risk; global expansion cautious but intentional

risks.title: Risks & watch-items
risks.body: India’s cost-sensitive pricing environment; geopolitical delays in global expansion; dependency on AWS pricing stability; credit risk from new clients (exited Dubai gaming deal due to credit concerns)

non_obvious.title: Non-obvious takeaways
non_obvious.body: IntelliOps AI platform is already deployed with 60%+ clients, reducing need for headcount growth despite revenue surge; AWS partnership grants preferential access to leads and funding incentives, creating a moat; AI revenue is embedded in cloud contracts, making pure-play AI revenue misleadingly low

other.title: Notable from the deck
other.body:
- [Client Decision] A Dubai contract worth ~Rs12 Cr ARR was declined due to payment exposure risk, with an estimated ~Rs4 Cr revenue impact for FY25-26.
- [Regulatory Exit] Gaming-sector clients exited following a government circular, discontinuing ~Rs73L of MRR (~Rs3.5 Cr FY25-26 revenue impact).
- [Risk Management] Disclosed key risks and mitigations: margin pressure -> improve services mix; talent availability -> internal capability programs; competitive intensity -> specialization and customer intimacy; hyperscaler dependency -> multi-solution strategy.
